input.prompt:
ORIGINAL miniboss character design sheet for a colorful post-apocalyptic plant-defense tower-defense game. Character name concept: THE BUNKER MUTANT / "Rootbreaker" — an underground creature mutated by toxic runoff and invasive plant growth. Do not copy any existing monster or game character.

Design: bulky asymmetrical mutant emerging from sewer/bunker culture, squat powerful silhouette readable on a phone, one oversized arm protected by cracked concrete-like growth, smaller claw arm, mossy skin, fluorescent toxic sacs, roots/vines fused into back and shoulders, scavenged non-branded metal scraps embedded into body, expressive face that is menacing but still cartoonishly readable. Palette: moss green, dirty orange, toxic yellow-green glow, concrete gray, small teal accents.

Art style: polished playful casual-game cartoon, chunky proportions, clean outline, soft cel shading, vivid colors, original IP, no realism, no gore, no text/logo.

Create one consistent top-down/3/4 sprite-source sheet on simple warm background:
1) dormant/crouched state,
2) awakening pose,
3) active idle,
4) heavy slam anticipation,
5) slam impact,
6) stagger/hit pose.
Keep the same anatomy, proportions and camera angle across all poses so it can guide Unity animation.
